title: Underground atomic blast for natural gas (Gasbuggy)

tellings.quote: Where the government once detonated an atomic bomb underground to blast open natural gas reserves?

plain: Near Aztec, New Mexico, the government once set off an atomic bomb underground to blast open natural gas reserves, a test known as Gasbuggy. Michels mentions it himself, without a source, while describing the area where he says alien bodies were recovered from a crash.
